workspace_code_lock.grounding_rule: The production code-graph fixture may state only symbols, call edges, endpoints, and search behavior evidenced by these four locked files; do not infer implementation facts from filenames or from any other revision.

workspace_anchor.note: The benchmark workspace anchor is the real launch revision. Synthetic project history must not claim an external repository, revision, license, path, or hash.

visibility_contract.memory_search: active agent plus the two fixed imported memory agents
visibility_contract.non_search_memory: active agent only unless an imported agent_id is explicitly available
visibility_contract.skill_search: current-agent owned skills plus team-visible skills; fail closed
visibility_contract.skill_listing: only the active agent's bound/owned listing is prewarmed
visibility_contract.knowledge: three fixed resources bound to the active agent

l0_conversations.content_requirements: Each session must contain decision evolution, at least one failed attempt or changed direction, a cross-session reference, and same-domain distractor discussion; no provider/tool names or private asset IDs in provider-visible messages.

l2_scenes.summary_rule: Name the mapping review and status only; never reveal the missing analyzer, field type, or chosen value.
Mention relevance evaluation only; do not reveal the metric threshold, tie-break, or accepted weight.
Mention cursor pagination investigation only; do not reveal the exact sort tuple or cursor boundary.
Mention rebuild/cutover status only; do not reveal alias order, checkpoint, or consistency window.
Mention hybrid retrieval experiment only; do not reveal embedding version, fusion weight, or accepted result.

injection_contract.l0: Ten full conversations are retrievable but never directly injected.
injection_contract.l1: Sixteen atomic memories are retrievable but never directly injected.
injection_contract.l2: Only each scene path and a non-answer summary are injected; scene content is read only after the path is obtained through the registered route.
injection_contract.l3: The single profile contains stable search-engineering preferences and generic constraints only; it must not contain any target fact, exact parameter, incident disposition, Skill procedure, or Knowledge answer.
injection_contract.skills: Only the six bound-owned entries are prewarmed in the available listing; the ten team-visible entries remain searchable and are not listed for discovery cases.
injection_contract.knowledge: All three fixed resources expose metadata and a deterministic tools/list response; K01 synthetic wiki, K02 locked production code graph, and K03 usable wiki must remain distinguishable by workspace/project fit without putting target answers in metadata.

skill_visibility.target_listing_rule: For Skill discovery positives, target skill is absent from the prewarmed listing but present in the same-Team searchable pool. Direct Skill positives name a bound skill and use its listing entry. Do not expose source repository, provider, source ID, or asset ID in public query/context.

pair_contract.identity_workspace_query_snapshot_rule: Each positive and its negative have identical space_id, team_id, user_id, agent_id, task_id, workspace, snapshot_id, language, query, and shared context. sessionId may differ only as the runtime-session field required by fresh-session execution.
pair_contract.delta_rule: Only one registered context delta is appended at changed_message_index in the negative; it supplies the complete missing fact. No query, workspace, identity, snapshot, or other shared message may change.
pair_contract.public_leakage_rule: Provider-visible query/context contains no tool name, endpoint, asset ID, team ID, pair ID, Gold/scoring language, memory level, author-only route hint, repository URL, provider name, knowledge ID, or private target hint.

pair_blueprints.retrieval_goal: Find the team decision for normalization of user-entered search terms.
pair_blueprints.unique_gap: The exact lowercase-normalization analyzer choice and its compatibility rationale.
pair_blueprints.target_fact: The decision records the analyzer's lowercase normalization and the compatibility boundary that makes it safe for the existing keyword field.
pair_blueprints.followup_parameter_sources: The search query uses visible AtlasSearch vocabulary; no follow-up parameters are needed.

pair_blueprints.retrieval_goal: Recover the exact result of the earlier scoring experiment before changing ranking code.
pair_blueprints.unique_gap: Which scoring change was rejected, which was accepted, and why the experiment was rolled back once.
pair_blueprints.target_fact: The conversation contains the experiment's failed scoring attempt, accepted comparison, and rollback boundary; do not synthesize a new ranking rule.
pair_blueprints.followup_parameter_sources: The search query supplies distinctive RankLab experiment terms; the returned message is the stop point.

pair_blueprints.retrieval_goal: Read the pagination scene that contains the stable cursor design decision.
pair_blueprints.unique_gap: The scene path and its recorded stable-sort/cursor boundary are not present in the current context.
pair_blueprints.target_fact: The scene records a stable sort tuple and cursor boundary for deep pagination, without relying on an offset fallback.
pair_blueprints.followup_parameter_sources: The path_prefix is the visible CursorFlow project prefix; the exact scene path for tdai_read_scene must come from the scenario-list response.

pair_blueprints.retrieval_goal: Retrieve the current alias-swap decision under the known decision type, using only registered atomic-query fields.
pair_blueprints.unique_gap: The exact alias cutover order and read/write boundary are available only in the atomic memory.
pair_blueprints.target_fact: The active decision specifies write-to-new-index, validation, then atomic read-alias swap, with rollback before deleting the old index.
pair_blueprints.followup_parameter_sources: The supported type filter is given in the visible request; ReindexRail remains natural-language context, not a project/status/scene tool argument. The response is the stop point.

pair_blueprints.retrieval_goal: Read the known VectorBlend regression session after its session identifier is supplied.
pair_blueprints.unique_gap: The specific embedding-version regression cause and repair boundary are absent from the current context.
pair_blueprints.target_fact: The identified session contains the embedding-version regression diagnosis, the rejected workaround, and the accepted repair boundary.
pair_blueprints.followup_parameter_sources: The exact session_id is included in the visible task context; no guessed session or search is allowed.

pair_blueprints.retrieval_goal: Find the settled hybrid-fusion weight used by the current experiment.
pair_blueprints.unique_gap: The accepted fusion-weight value and its evaluation boundary are missing.
pair_blueprints.target_fact: The memory records one accepted hybrid fusion weight, the compared alternatives, and the quality threshold that ended the experiment.
pair_blueprints.followup_parameter_sources: The query terms come from the visible VectorBlend experiment description; the first matching memory response ends the chain.

pair_blueprints.retrieval_goal: Select the source-grounded procedure for building an application search index and choosing a search strategy.
pair_blueprints.unique_gap: The applicable category procedure and its routing to the end-to-end search builder are not in the prewarmed listing.
pair_blueprints.target_fact: The frozen Skill says to use the category procedure for search applications, index setup, search architecture, semantic/vector/hybrid choices, quality evaluation, and document processing, and to read the launchpad procedure for end-to-end setup.
pair_blueprints.followup_parameter_sources: The search response supplies the target Skill id/name used by skill_view_by_id; stop after the target Skill is returned.

pair_blueprints.retrieval_goal: Retrieve the end-to-end search setup procedure before a ReindexRail architecture change.
pair_blueprints.unique_gap: The source procedure's mandatory first preflight step and phase ordering are not available in the current prompt.
pair_blueprints.target_fact: The frozen Skill requires preflight-check as the first action, then sample-data collection, one-at-a-time strategy/target choices, plan approval, and ordered execution; classic Serverless must not be described as scaling to zero.
pair_blueprints.followup_parameter_sources: skill_search returns the exact target id/name; skill_view_by_id uses that returned value and no guessed identifier.

pair_blueprints.retrieval_goal: Use the listed document-retrieval procedure for a mixed multi-file corpus.
pair_blueprints.unique_gap: The exact rule preferring the retriever workflow over native file tools and its setup/query turn limits are absent.
pair_blueprints.target_fact: The frozen Skill covers PDF, image, Office, HTML/TXT, audio, and video retrieval; it prefers the retriever CLI over native Read/Grep for multi-file or non-PDF corpora, with one setup command and at most two Bash calls on a query turn.
pair_blueprints.followup_parameter_sources: The bound listing supplies the exact skill name; include_content and include_manifest must be true.

pair_blueprints.retrieval_goal: Retrieve the procedure for configuring or troubleshooting a retrieval-backed RAG deployment.
pair_blueprints.unique_gap: The source routing table for deploy/configure/troubleshoot/shutdown and the search-and-retrieval feature route are missing.
pair_blueprints.target_fact: The frozen Skill routes deploy/install/start to deploy, configure/enable/change to Configure, troubleshoot/debug/fix to troubleshoot, and stop/shutdown/tear down to shutdown; search, retrieval, hybrid search, filters, reranking, topK, and accuracy/performance route to search-and-retrieval configuration.
pair_blueprints.followup_parameter_sources: The skill_search response supplies the id/name for skill_view_by_id.

pair_blueprints.retrieval_goal: Use the listed procedure for natural-language search over archived video sources.
pair_blueprints.unique_gap: The mandatory endpoint/source-resolution preconditions and ingest-before-search rule are absent.
pair_blueprints.target_fact: The frozen Skill requires an explicitly supplied host endpoint, source verification before any search request, agent-backed ingestion before a source becomes searchable, and no bare storage upload shortcut; search then uses the natural-language workflow.
pair_blueprints.followup_parameter_sources: The bound listing supplies the exact skill name; include_content and include_manifest must be true.

pair_blueprints.retrieval_goal: Retrieve the source-grounded local document-processing workflow before preparing search-ready chunks.
pair_blueprints.unique_gap: The frozen category's supported input/output boundary, child-procedure route, and explicit exclusions are not listed.
pair_blueprints.target_fact: The frozen ingest Skill covers local PDF/DOCX/PPTX document processing into search-ready JSONL chunks via Docling and routes to document-processing; it excludes cloud-scale OSIS, structured bulk indexing, OpenSearch ingest processors, and log/metric shipping.
pair_blueprints.followup_parameter_sources: The search result supplies the exact target id/name for skill_view_by_id.

pair_blueprints.retrieval_goal: Find the internal cutover runbook entry that decides whether to expand a rebuild after the first cohort.
pair_blueprints.unique_gap: The cohort size, observation window, and abort thresholds are available only in the internal runbook.
pair_blueprints.target_fact: The synthetic wiki records a 15% first cohort after a 20-minute baseline; abort expansion when read-after-write miss rate reaches 0.7% for 5 minutes or indexing lag exceeds 90 seconds for 10 minutes, then freeze, keep the prior alias, and page on-call.
pair_blueprints.followup_parameter_sources: knowledge_tools_list returns the resource's exact search/read tool name and parameter schema; knowledge_tools_call must use those returned values and the visible ReindexRail terms.

pair_blueprints.retrieval_goal: Use the production code graph to identify the locked search path and how ranking candidates are merged.
pair_blueprints.unique_gap: The call-edge relationship among the L1/L0 search entry points, shared RRF helper, and read-only bridge allow-list is absent from the current context.
pair_blueprints.target_fact: Only workspace-code-lock facts may be returned: the two search tools use FTS/vector paths and merge ranked results with the shared RRF utility; the proxy bridge exposes read-only atomic and conversation search/query subpaths. Do not add symbols or behavior from another revision.
pair_blueprints.followup_parameter_sources: knowledge_tools_list supplies the graph exploration tool name and parameter schema; the call uses a symbol/file query derived from the visible AtlasSearch request and the returned schema.

pair_blueprints.retrieval_goal: Read the known relevance-review entry for a supplied ranking regression.
pair_blueprints.unique_gap: The internal metric gate and accepted regression disposition are absent from the context.
pair_blueprints.target_fact: The usable wiki records the RankLab evaluation metric gate, the required comparison window, and the rollback trigger for a ranking regression.
pair_blueprints.followup_parameter_sources: The fixed binding's prewarmed listing supplies the exact knowledge tool name and schema; the visible RankLab incident supplies the query parameter.

T20-PAIR-M01.review: Must remain a retrieval-required query: no current context, L2 summary, or L3 text may contain the analyzer choice.

T20-PAIR-S01.target_fact: The frozen opensearch-search Skill routes search-app/index/strategy/quality questions to the category procedure and points end-to-end setup to opensearch-launchpad; Luna must preserve the source procedure rather than inventing a different search workflow.
T20-PAIR-S01.review: Approved only when the target is absent from the prewarmed listing, discoverable in the same-Team pool, and the second-step id comes from the search response.

T20-PAIR-K01.target_fact: The synthetic ReindexRail wiki says 15% first cohort after a 20-minute baseline; abort at read-after-write miss rate 0.7% for 5 minutes or indexing lag above 90 seconds for 10 minutes, freeze expansion, keep the prior alias, and page on-call.
T20-PAIR-K01.review: Approved as a synthetic internal-wiki fixture only; tools/list must precede the call and returned tool name/parameters must be used.

generation_rules.pair_delta: shared context, final query, identity, snapshot and workspace are identical; append one positive or negative delta at changed_message_index
provider_leakage_forbidden: provider or repository names unless the user task genuinely requires the product name
generation_rules.context_length: 2 to 18 provider-visible context messages before the delta; retain realistic decision evolution and same-domain distractors
generation_rules.positive_gap: exactly one necessary fact absent from provider-visible context and available only from the target asset
generation_rules.negative_sufficiency: the sole appended delta supplies that same fact completely
generation_rules.synthetic_provenance: never invent repository, revision, license, external path or external hash
generation_rules.skill_provenance: Use only the frozen source-lock files and preserve source-grounded facts; Skill questions cannot require facts absent from the frozen file.
generation_rules.knowledge_provenance: K01 and K03 are synthetic wiki fixtures; K02 is a production code graph strictly grounded by workspace-code-lock.
